```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
df_pd = pd.DataFrame({
    "spend": [500, 1000, 1500, 800, 1200],
    "customer": ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]
})

# Convert to narwhals
df = nw.from_native(df_pd)

# Add tier column with conditional expression
df = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000)
        .then(nw.lit("gold"))
        .otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
)

# Display result
print(df.to_native())
```
